posts.title: What the PHP2Shell rumors got wrong, from inside the PHP security team
posts.description: The PHP2Shell leak got the severity right and most details wrong: an out-of-memory error turned into RCE, and the real stopgap went unmentioned.

posts.title: CVE-2026-91768: FastCGI allowed_clients compared only 96 of an IPv6 address's 128 bits
posts.description: php-fpm accepted FastCGI connections from any address sharing the first 96 bits of an allowed IPv6 address, because one memcmp asked for 12 bytes instead of 16.

posts.title: CVE-2026-91766: PHP had the redirect credential leak curl fixed in 2018
posts.description: PHP's http:// stream wrapper sent Authorization, Cookie and Proxy-Authorization to any host a redirect pointed at, the bug curl fixed in 2018.
